purpose: Independent pre-implementation core receiving for the original RecallWeave union-find learning explorer

compression.find: Full compression rewires every encountered nonroot to that find's root; other parent entries and every size entry remain unchanged.
compression.union: Call find(a), then find(b), using the same compression setting, before deciding whether to merge.

union.different_components: Attach smaller component root to larger; equal cardinalities select lower root index regardless of argument order.
union.same_component: May perform the declared find compression, but does not merge or increase a root size.

snapshots.parent: Exactly n integer indices forming a rooted forest; roots point to themselves.
snapshots.size: Exactly n integers. Each root stores its graph component cardinality; every nonroot stores zero.
snapshots.components: Integer number of connected components. Extra display metadata is outside the core acceptance gate.

independent_oracle: Recompute connected components by BFS over the undirected edges authored by union operations; validate each forest against those sets. Root choices use graph component cardinalities. Exact compression/mutation fences are checked per transition, plus independently written literal golden arrays.
coverage: Five literal histories including depth three, descending tie arguments, larger high-index root winning, self/redundant unions, independent path compression and both find calls inside a redundant union.
Every two-operation program over n=1..4, in both compression modes.
32 deterministic 32-operation histories for each n=1..8, in both compression modes.
Omitted-option default, empty histories and inclusive 32-operation boundary.
Contract-invalid dimensions, operations and compression settings refuse without mutating unfrozen input; the receiver compares exact post-refusal input values.
Deliberately malformed trace controls prove the receiver detects partition, cycle, range, size, representative, compression and snapshot-count errors.
limits: This receiver is for the synchronous mathematical trace API; browser interaction, visual design, downloaded files, course answer keys and scientific learning effectiveness require separate receiving.
No original product implementation is imported for the freeze self-check; the positive self-check uses literal authored expected states.
This is advisory external source coordination, not a resident native goal or lease.
